errors.previewStale: The campaign or the preview expiry has changed. Run the check again.
errors.previewInvalid: The preview signature is invalid. Run the check again.
errors.notesSize: The entry notes are too large. Shorten the description or deselect this section/entry.
errors.requestSize: The selected set is too large. Choose fewer categories or sections.
errors.forbidden: Only the campaign DM has access, via a session.
errors.importFailed: The import failed. No partial record was committed; try again with the same key.
errors.fileSize: The file is too large: 3 MiB maximum. Choose a smaller file.
errors.parsingTimeout: Parsing took too long. Choose a smaller file.
errors.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
errors.recordSize: A record in the category {kind} is too large.
errors.httpError: HTTP_ERROR: check the selection and repeat the preview
errors.unknownCode: {code}: check the selection and repeat the preview
errors.reportUnavailable: The report is no longer available
errors.optionsLoadFailed: Could not load the dependency options; repeat the preview
